name: High-Energy X-ray Diffraction and Imaging (XSD Materials Physics & Engineering)
notes: APS operations beamline for high-energy (50-100 keV class) diffraction/imaging of bulk materials. Do-no-harm beamline under APS-U; Aug 2025 APS update mentions new hypersonic-materials test rig being designed for 1-ID with the upgraded beam, but explicit user-operations status not sourced.

name: Optics and Detector Testing / X-ray Topography (XSD)
notes: Journal of Crystal Growth paper reports the topography beamline 1-BM was recommissioned in January 2025 after the APS Upgrade.

name: Nuclear Resonant Scattering (XSD)
techniques: nuclear forward scattering / synchrotron Moessbauer spectroscopy
notes: Works at nuclear resonance energies (e.g. 57Fe 14.4 keV; 83Kr, 151Eu, 161Dy planned); 1.5x12 um focus for 57Fe. SEES reports full general user operations restored for APS 2025-3 cycle.

name: POLAR - Polarization Modulation Spectroscopy (APS-U feature beamline)
techniques: diffraction under magnetic field / pressure / strain
notes: One of nine APS-U feature beamlines; quantum/magnetic materials with tunable polarization, high field, extreme pressure, uniaxial strain environments. First light late 2024/early 2025; per MEDSI'25 all feature beamlines met KPPs. Full general-user status as of 2026 not explicitly sourced.

name: DND-CAT (DuPont-Northwestern-Dow) insertion device beamline
techniques: X-ray scattering of polymers and soft matter
notes: Operated by Northwestern University with Dow and DuPont. Post-APS-U operations status not directly sourced.

name: DND-CAT bending magnet beamline
notes: 5-BM-B/D stations; DND-CAT. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: Multi-Anvil Press / energy-dispersive diffraction (6-BM-B)
notes: SEES-affiliated; scientific commissioning completed and full general user operations restored for APS 2025-3 cycle.

name: Magnetic and high-energy scattering (XSD; 6-ID-B,C and 6-ID-D)
notes: Post-APS-U user-operations status not directly sourced.

name: Time-Resolved X-ray Science (XSD)
notes: Dedicated to pump-probe experiments with ultrafast high-intensity lasers. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: Time-resolved fluid dynamics imaging (XSD Imaging)
notes: Runs the shared TomoScan tomography control system with 2-BM and 32-ID. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: XPCS - X-ray Photon Correlation Spectroscopy (APS-U feature beamline; 8-ID-E/8-ID-I)
techniques: X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (small-angle and wide-angle)
dynamics of liquids, gels, glasses and quantum materials
notes: First APS-U feature beamline declared ready for science (November 2024) and first to take users; exploits the upgraded ring's increased coherence.

name: CSSI - Coherent Surface Scattering Imaging (APS-U feature beamline)
techniques: 3D imaging of thin films, surfaces and interfaces
notes: APS-U feature beamline; includes the 'Grand Tube' long flight path. In commissioning per 2024-2025 APS-U updates. (Former 9-ID USAXS program relocated to 12-ID-E.)

name: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XSD Spectroscopy)
notes: General-purpose XAS beamline (9-BM-B,C). Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: MR-CAT (Materials Research CAT) insertion device beamline
notes: Operated by an IIT-led consortium; catalysis, environmental and materials spectroscopy. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: MR-CAT bending magnet beamline
notes: Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: High-Resolution Powder Diffractometer (mail-in service)
notes: APS Structural Science group reports scientific commissioning complete after APS-U enhancements; 11-BM accepting user proposals (initially limited) in 2025.

name: Total scattering / Pair Distribution Function beamline
notes: Dedicated PDF station; fixed energies of 59 and 87 keV. Scientific commissioning complete after APS-U; accepting (initially limited) user proposals in 2025.

name: High-energy diffraction beamline
notes: Very high fixed-energy (~100 keV class) station. Scientific commissioning complete after APS-U; accepting (initially limited) user proposals in 2025.

name: SAXS/WAXS and GISAXS beamline (XSD Chemical & Materials Science)
notes: Solids and solutions. Post-APS-U user-operations status not directly sourced.

name: USAXS/SAXS/WAXS facility and 10 m SAXS (USAXS relocated from 9-ID under APS-U)
notes: USAXS at 12-ID-E since the 2024 APS-U upgrade; q-range ~1e-5 to ~10 1/A; ~2000 h/yr allocated.

name: XAS with combined SAXS/WAXS (XSD)
notes: Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: GSECARS high-pressure insertion device stations
techniques: large volume press / Paris-Edinburgh press experiments
notes: Earth/planetary science under extreme P-T. In scientific commissioning through APS 2025-2/2025-3 cycles; some user experiments supported.

name: GSECARS bending magnet station C
notes: Full general user operations restored for APS 2025-3 cycle.

name: GSECARS bending magnet station D
notes: Large volume press at 100% operations; full general user operations for 2025-3 cycle.

name: BioCARS (University of Chicago) - time-resolved structural biology
notes: Pink beam at ~12 keV with 2.5-5.5% bandpass; single-pulse isolation. 2025 publications describe active post-APS-U capabilities.

name: NSF's ChemMatCARS (University of Chicago)
techniques: advanced small-molecule crystallography (including quantum crystallography and DAFS)
notes: 15-ID-B (new hutch, mail-in crystallography), 15-ID-D (high-energy/in-situ diffraction); 2025 paper describes upgrades in progress; cycle-by-cycle status not explicitly sourced.

name: HPCAT high-pressure micro-diffraction (Carnegie/DOE-NNSA)
techniques: high-pressure diamond anvil cell X-ray diffraction
notes: HPCAT newsletter (June 2026): 16-ID-B in regular user mode with general-purpose and laser-heating tables fully operational.

name: HPCAT high-pressure spectroscopy stations
notes: 16-ID-C-D-E undulator branch accepted beam September 2025; nearing completion of final commissioning per HPCAT.

name: HPCAT bending magnet micro-focus station
notes: Fixed-exit geometry, 6-60 keV; Laue microdiffraction setup available to users in 2025.

name: HPCAT white/energy-dispersive station (Paris-Edinburgh press)
notes: Per-station status of 16-BM-B not explicitly stated during phased restart.

name: IMCA-CAT (Industrial Macromolecular Crystallography Association)
techniques: automated robotic sample mounting and data collection
notes: Pharma structure-based drug discovery; beamline rebuilt for the upgraded APS (2025 paper describes post-APS-U operation).

name: Rapid Acquisition Powder Diffraction (XSD Structural Science)
techniques: rapid in-situ/operando powder X-ray diffraction (area detector)
notes: Tunable 27-51 keV; battery/catalysis/gas-loading sample environments. Commissioning complete; (initially limited) user proposals accepted in 2025.

name: BioCAT (Biophysics CAT, Illinois Institute of Technology)
techniques: biological solution small-angle X-ray scattering (SEC-SAXS, time-resolved SAXS, FFF-SAXS)
notes: Resumed user operations with the APS 2025-1 run; new high-flux low-divergence microbeams, automated SEC-SAXS/coflow autosampler.

name: SBC-CAT Structural Biology Center 19-ID (historical)
notes: SBC's 19-ID and 19-BM closed before the APS Upgrade (>6,590 PDB depositions); DOE-BER role passed to eBERlight. Sector 19 ID position now hosts the ISN feature beamline.

name: ISN - In Situ Nanoprobe (APS-U feature beamline, Long Beamline Building)
notes: Hard X-ray nanoprobe 220 m from source; ~20 nm focus with 50 mm working distance for in situ/operando environments. First light expected during the 2024-2025 run; full user-program status not explicitly sourced.

name: SBC-CAT Structural Biology Center 19-BM (historical)
notes: Closed before the APS Upgrade along with 19-ID as SBC concluded operations.

name: HEXM - High-Energy X-ray Microscope (APS-U feature beamline, Long Beamline Building)
techniques: high-energy X-ray imaging/tomography of bulk samples
in situ defect tracking in materials
notes: ~600-ft beamline with superconducting undulator; monochromatic 35-120 keV, white-beam capable; cm-sized samples in in situ environments. First light expected 2024-2025 run.

name: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy bending magnet beamline (XSD Spectroscopy; eBERlight partner)
notes: Si(111) monochromator, 3.9-32 keV focused; APS directory lists full general user mode; 2025 paper describes multifunctional capillary XRF for tissue sections.

name: LS-CAT (Life Sciences CAT; 21-ID-D/E/F/G)
notes: Four MX stations; 21-ID-D supports serial MX and cryo/ambient switching; described as active at the upgraded APS in the 2026 SRN MX review.

name: SER-CAT (Southeast Regional CAT, University of Georgia)
notes: Post-APS-U: new KB mirror system and MD3 micro-diffractometer on 22-ID-D; developing fully automated AI-driven data collection pipeline (2026 SRN MX review).

name: GM/CA@APS (NIH-funded)
notes: Returned to scientific operations 11 March 2025 after technical commissioning from 22 November 2024; 23-ID-D max energy raised to 35 keV, >1e13 ph/s, Eiger2 XE 16M CdTe detector.

name: NE-CAT (Northeastern CAT, Cornell University)
notes: 2025 paper reports NE-CAT implemented key post-upgrade improvements and continues serving users.

name: Microprobe and Advanced Spectroscopy (XSD Spectroscopy)
techniques: X-ray microprobe (beams to ~1 um; 2 um confocal)
notes: Si(111) mono, 1e14 ph/s at 10 keV, 2x2 um focus; APS directory states accepting general user proposals while commissioning continues.

name: Hard X-ray Nanoprobe (CNM/APS)
notes: Operated by CNM's Electron and X-ray Microscopy group. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: RIXS beamline (XSD Inelastic X-ray Scattering)
notes: November 2025 APS-U update describes users running experiments at the newly upgraded 27-ID RIXS beamline.

name: CHEX - Coherent High-Energy X-ray Sector for In Situ Science (APS-U feature beamline)
techniques: in situ high-energy X-ray diffraction and scattering during materials synthesis
notes: Four independently operating branches, eight stations, 15-60 keV. First light July 2025 per APS-U August 2025 update.

name: IEX - Intermediate Energy X-ray (29-ID-C,D)
notes: Two end stations: ARPES (30x10 um beam, 6-300 K, Scienta R4000) and RSXS. APS directory lists IEX as currently accepting general users.

name: HERIX - High-Energy-Resolution Inelastic X-ray Scattering (XSD)
notes: 119Sn nuclear resonance experiments cited as performable at 30-ID; explicit post-APS-U status not sourced.

name: Full-Field Imaging and Transmission X-ray Microscopy (32-ID-B,C)
techniques: white and monochromatic beam tomography and radiography
notes: Stations at ~37 m (TXM) and ~70 m (high-speed imaging); shares TomoScan controls with 2-BM/7-BM. Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: PtychoProbe - Ptychography/Spectromicroscopy (APS-U feature beamline)
notes: Final APS-U feature beamline to be installed; intended to be the highest-spatial-resolution instrument at APS; first light expected October 2025.

name: Diffraction / surface & interface scattering bending magnet (33-BM-C)
notes: Post-APS-U status not directly sourced.

name: ATOMIC - coherent diffraction imaging (APS-U feature beamline)
techniques: coherent X-ray diffraction imaging of nanocrystals, strain and defects
notes: ATOMIC built at 34-ID under APS-U to exploit ~100x coherent flux gains. Feature beamlines met KPPs per MEDSI'25; per-station general-user status as of 2026 not explicitly sourced.

name: 3DMN - 3D Micro and Nano Diffraction (APS-U feature beamline)
notes: In technical commissioning as of August 2025; first experiments expected early 2026 and entry into the general user program during the first or second 2026 run.

name: DCS - Dynamic Compression Sector (Washington State University / DOE-NNSA)
techniques: time-resolved X-ray diffraction under dynamic (shock) compression
gas gun and two-stage light gas gun impact loading (0.4-6.9 km/s)
laser-driven shock compression (100 J Nd:glass laser)
notes: NNSA-sponsored sector for condensed matter under dynamic loading to >350 GPa on ns-us timescales; active 2025 experiments.
